evidence.notes: A typed String query and Map<String,Object> binds with SYSTEM_MODE produce a cursor in deployable Apex test context.

source.content: @isTest private class DataDatabaseCursorSystemModeRuntimeDepthTest { @isTest static void cursorWithBindsRunsInSystemMode() { insert new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'Cursor First', Rating = 'Hot'), new Account(Name = 'Cursor Second', Rating = 'Warm'), new Account(Name = 'Cursor Third', Rating = 'Warm')}; Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>{'rating' => 'Warm'}; Database.Cursor cursor = Database.getCursorWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Rating = :rating ORDER BY Name', binds, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(2, cursor.getNumRecords()); List<SObject> rows = cursor.fetch(0, 2); System.assertEquals('Cursor Second', ((Account)rows[0]).Name); System.assertEquals('Cursor Third', ((Account)rows[1]).Name); } }
